MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- bound {PLAYER}?
WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
If you challenge him with WATER-type POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!
And, he's put in switch-controlled doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!
Hey, go for it!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor: Whoa, you're electrifying! You've powered the door open!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro: My electric soul, it'll shatter your dreams whole, whoa-yeahah!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat: That was plugged in, amped up, over-driven electric, man!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart, whoa-yeah!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro: I trained under WATTSON! There ain't no way I'll lose easily!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle:
WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been around for a long, long time.
He was battling even before your daddy was born, that tough coot.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro: This GYM's got puzzles! Isn't it fun?
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle: WATTSON says he likes setting up little traps with switches.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves, you'll be shocked!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle:
I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded by WATTSON.
He was a TRAINER long before we became TRAINERS. He must know all sorts of things!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny forehead. It makes me happy!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro:
I've given up on my plans to convert the city, I have.
And so, I put my time into making door traps in my GYM.
Oh? Now, what are you doing here?
What's that? You say you've gotten past all my rigged doors?
Wahahahah! Now, that is amusing!
Then, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat:
Wahahahah! Fine, I lost!
You ended up giving me a thrill! Take this BADGE!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadg: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE from WATTSON.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadge:
With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can use ROCK SMASH out of battle.
And, it will make your POKéMON a little bit faster, too.
Hmm… You should take this, too!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave:
That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.
It's a trustworthy move that never misses! You can count on it!
… … … … … …
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON in the POKéNAV.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising young TRAINER like you!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndE: Wahahahah! Go forth and endeavor, youngster!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified:
MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM
WATTSON'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON!
Wahahahaha!
I'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch:
WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our batteries again.
When we're fully charged up, we'll gladly accept your challenge.
So, come back again sometime, won't you?
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeed:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON!
Wahahahaha!
Oops! Wait! You've only one POKéMON with you!
Come see me with two or more POKéMON, all right?
